entities.summary: Cromwell Fleetwood Varley, FRSA was an English engineer, particularly associated with the development of the electric telegraph and the transatlantic telegraph cable. He also took interest in the claims of parapsychology and spiritualism. C. F. Varley was a architects & engineers from London (1828-04-06, London–1883-09-02). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
